newsitem.title: USA: Pulitzer sees tough earnings comparisons.
newsitem.headline: Pulitzer sees tough earnings comparisons.

text.p: Pulitzer Publishing Co said Wednesday that it expects to face tough earnings comparisons in the second half of 1997.

On Wednesday, Pulitzer reported second-quarter earnings of $0.89 a share versus $0.74 last year. The company said advertising revenues were strong and newsprint expenses, excluding Pulitzer Community Newspapers Inc, were down 25.3 percent.

"Looking ahead, we'll face tough earnings comparisons in the remainder of 1997, since broadcasting benefited from strong advertising in connection with the Summer Olympics and from $10 million in political advertising in the second half of 1996," Michael Pulitzer, chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.
"In addition, we face the possibility of higher newsprint prices in our publishing segment," he added.
Pulitzer is a newspaper publishing and television and radio broadcasting company.
